simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to גַּת־רִמּוֹן (H1667) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: גַּת־רִמּוֹן (Gath-Rimmôwn) means Gath-Rimmon , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 1Chr 6 54.

definitions.full: H1667. Gath -rimmon גַּתרִֿמּוֺן proper name, of a location in Dan Josh 19:45 ; Levitical city 21:24 = 1Chr 6:54 ; site unknown. — רִמּוֺן גַּת in Manasseh Josh 21:25 is scribal error; read יִבְלְעָם , q. v.
